title: Collection Keeper Arcade
intro: Backpacks (lists), scrolls (tuples) and phonebooks (dicts) hold your treasures! Grab the right items and store them well. First-try wins earn ⭐⭐⭐!

rounds.explain: Lists start counting at 0, so fruits[0] is the first item: apple.

rounds.prompt: Which collection CANNOT be changed after you make it?
rounds.explain: Tuples are like unchangeable scrolls — once written, they stay the same.
A dictionary looks up a value by its key. The key "Mia" points to 11.

rounds.prompt: This crashes! The list only has 3 items. Pick the fix.
options: Use a valid index like colors[2]
rounds.explain: 3 items use indexes 0, 1, 2. Index 3 doesn't exist, so it errors out.

rounds.prompt: How do you add a new item to the end of a list called bag?
rounds.explain: .append() drops a new item neatly onto the end of the list.

rounds.prompt: Build a list of two pets, then print the first one.
rounds.explain: Create the list first, then use index [0] to grab the first pet.
